project_type: Multi-repo healthtech platform: NestJS-like Lambda backend + React/Vite admin portal + static landing pages
build_system: pnpm workspaces, esbuild via Serverless Framework (backend), Vite (web)
test_framework: jest (backend), vitest (web) — tests exist but are not comprehensive
build_command: Backend: npm run build, Web: npx vite build --base=/admin/
test_command: Backend: npm run type-check, Web: npx tsc -b --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Type-check passes in both repos. 2. Manual testing via AWS CLI for Cognito groups. 3. curl for API endpoints. 4. Browser test for admin dashboard.
environment_constraints: AWS profile moovv-fit-ujwal-admin required for Cognito CLI commands. Pool A: ap-south-1_AulfstD9s. Pool B staging: ap-south-1_2Pgnh951U. Admin client ID: 3855djhdraj4trm2a6mkqn7f48.
contribution_requirements: Use existing patterns: adminAuth middleware, handler envelope pattern (createSuccessEnvelope/createErrorEnvelope), TanStack Query for web API calls. No inline styles in web (use Tailwind). Commit with conventional commits.
key_patterns: Backend handlers: async (event, context) => APIGatewayProxyResult, use verifyAdminToken() for admin routes. Web API: axios client at @/lib/axios, TanStack useQuery hooks. Admin portal auth: googleAuth.ts with getAdminIdToken().
directory_structure: Backend: /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node (handlers at src/handlers/, auth at src/shared/auth/, middleware at src/shared/middleware/, services at src/shared/services/, models at src/database/models/). Web: /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-web (pages at src/pages/, components at src/components/, API at src/api/, auth lib at src/lib/auth/). Landing: /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-landing (specs at .agents/specs/unified-auth/).
